title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-taylor-chen
content:
Console / Observability - triage scratchpad (Taylor Chen)

Quick context:
- Personal scratchpad for daily triage. informal.
- Primary focus: dashboard bugs, customer-reported issues, follow-ups to SRE/infra/console teams.
- Use this to capture repro notes, next steps, and people to ping.

2026-03-02 - morning sweep
- ACME Corp latency spike (reported via support INC-4523)
  - Symptoms: Dashboard load time > 8s for model-perf route, customers seeing timeouts in UI.
  - Affected dashboards: /console/models/model-perf-overview, /console/tenants/acme/perf
  - Initial triage: spikes align with increased KV-cache misses around 08:20 PST.
  - Slack thread: #observability-triage (see linked_artifacts).
  - Quick repro: open model-perf-overview, toggle timeframe to 1h -> load times blow up.
  - Next steps: 
    1) Ping infra on KV-cache eviction logs (Jordan).
    2) Pull traces for 08:15-08:30 from Jaeger (me).
    3) Add temporary alert for model-perf route 95th pct > 2s (low-risk) -> send to oncall.
  - Owners: Jordan (kv-cache), Taylor (traces + dashboard patch), Support assigned: Priya.
  - Notes: Could be traffic surge from internal load test? Check Deployments around 07:50-08:10.

2026-03-02 - afternoon follow-ups
- Dashboard tile wrong metric: "Tokens / s" shows raw token count not rate (reported by Olivia).
  - Root cause: frontend tile mapping uses counter.metric.total instead of counter.metric.rate.
  - Quick patch: change metric mapping in dashboard config (console-dashboard repo). Create PR with test screenshot.
  - Linked PR: github:repo/console-dashboard#PR342 (branch taylor/fix-tokens-rate)
  - TODO: add unit test to prevent regression (mock metrics).

- Customer report: tenant-specific graph missing for "dedicated capacity" filter (INC-4580)
  - Workaround: use global view + filter by tenant id in search bar.
  - Investigate: filter gating logic in backend route /api/dash/filters. Suspect recent change in dedicated-capacity flag check.
  - Owner: Samira (backend), Taylor (frontend repro + e2e).

Open action list (priority ordered)
- P0: ACME latency investigation 
  - Collect Jaeger traces (in progress)
  - Check KV-cache eviction thresholds (ask infra)
  - Add temporary 95th percentile alert -> oncall
- P1: Dashboard tokens/s mapping fix -> open PR, add unit test
- P1: Dedicated-capacity filter bug -> reproduce + add regression e2e (Samira)
- P2: Dashboard perf runbook update (confluence) -> record steps to collect cache + trace correlation
- P2: Add example queries to runbook for support team (Priya requested)
- Backlog: revisit dashboard tile rendering performance (lazy load charts)

Notes to self / misc
- When collecting traces, save span IDs in ticket and paste into Slack thread.
- If we see repeated cache evictions, consider bumping cache size for dedicated pool temporarily (must discuss with infra/cost).
- Remember to cc customer success on RCA draft for ACME (RCA draft due 2026-03-06).

Meeting: 2026-03-03 10:00 AM - quick sync with infra + support
- Agenda: ACME incident, KV-cache behavior, temporary mitigations, who drafts RCA
- Attendees: Jordan, Samira, Owen (infra), Priya (support), Taylor
- Prep: bring Jaeger traces + eviction logs + dashboard load samples

Repro checklist (for each reported dashboard issue)
- Step 1: capture screenshot + console network waterfall (Chrome)
- Step 2: note timeframe and tenant id (if tenant specific)
- Step 3: replicate in incognito to rule out cached frontend state
- Step 4: collect backend request id / span id -> paste into ticket
- Step 5: if perf, collect trace and flamegraph, save to confluence incident folder

Reminders
- Draft RCA for ACME by 2026-03-06 (assign to me)
- Update runbook with KV-cache investigation steps by EOD 2026-03-05
- Add unit test for tokens/s tile mapping before next release

Quick links (for my reference)
- Jaeger search: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search
- Kibana logs: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover
- Dashboard repo PRs: github:repo/console-dashboard/pulls
- Runbook: confluence:console-observability/runbook-quickstart

End of scratchpad entry.

-- Taylor
